dates.notes: The Arab Telecommunications and Information Council of Ministers (ATICM) decided to launch the unified Arab AI strategy at its 28th session in January 2025; the Saudi Press Agency reported the decision on 23 January 2025. The official Arabic text is published by AICTO and describes the text as a proposed unified strategic vision. No signature, ratification or entry-into-force clause exists.

gaps: Non-binding regional strategy: it creates no legal obligation, ratification, depositary, monitoring, reporting or enforcement.

checks.result: The 39-page AICTO PDF sets out a unified Arab strategic vision for AI, with governance, legislative environment, infrastructure, data, investment, SME and innovation axes and common Arab cooperation areas. It contains no treaty, signature, ratification or entry-into-force clause.

The Saudi Press Agency report of 23 January 2025 states that the Arab ICT Ministers Council decided to launch the unified Arab AI strategy. UN ESCWA's 2026 review also describes the strategy as adopted in 2025.
The text is a ministerial strategy prepared within the League of Arab States and published by AICTO. It is non-binding and creates no legal obligation or depositary.

verification.notes: Metadata verified from the official AICTO publication, the Saudi Press Agency report and the UN ESCWA review. The record is metadata-only: no full text is stored. The exact adoption date is the date of the public launch report, not a signature date.
